description:
Create a billing plan bundling one or more `entitlements`: WALLET (prepaid USD balance, debited at raw model cost — no margin), FLAT (one-off fee), CREDIT/OUTCOME/UNIT entitlements referencing an existing resource by id, or COMPOSITE referencing an existing composite by compositeId.

Rules:
- Create referenced credits/outcomes/units first (clocknext_create_credit / _outcome / _unit), then pass their ids. Every item referenced must be active.
- To SELL a composite, add a COMPOSITE entitlement with the composite's id as compositeId (clocknext_list_composites). This is the only thing that makes a composite bill — the catalogue entry alone charges nobody, errors nowhere, and looks configured. For ADVANCE, its quantity is a prepaid POOL of occurrence slots shared across the wrapped items.
- Each entitlement's billingMode is ADVANCE (up-front grant) or ARREAR (metered). An ADVANCE credit/outcome/unit/composite line needs `quantity` (0 is allowed); an ADVANCE WALLET line needs `amount` (0 is allowed); a FLAT line needs `amount` above 0. A field that doesn't fit the line is refused (400), never dropped.
- Set rollover:true on an ADVANCE credit/outcome/composite/wallet line to carry what's left into the next cycle.
- The price is the sum of the ADVANCE lines. Send `cost` only to set a different total.
- Set useWalletForArrear:true to pay metered (ARREAR) usage from the plan's prepaid WALLET as it happens (one invoice/cycle, wallet may go negative) instead of a separate cycle-end arrear invoice. Requires >=1 ARREAR credit/outcome/unit/composite AND an ADVANCE WALLET component, or the backend rejects it (400).
- FREE plans must be ADVANCE-only with no FLAT component, and never roll over.
- A plan name already in use is refused (409). The currency is the workspace's primary currency (Settings → Organization → Currencies); it can't be chosen here.
- Creates a real, sellable plan — get pricing right first. Prefer the plan builder in the Clocknext product (https://payments.clocknext.com/plans); this is the fallback.

billingCycle.description: Billing cadence. FREE is a one-time grant with no invoice.

carryForward.description: DEPRECATED — still accepted for back-compat but no longer read by the backend; setting it has no effect (carry-forward is fixed policy now: wallet money carries, allowances reset).

cost.description: The plan's total price per billing cycle (USD). Leave it out to price the plan at the sum of its ADVANCE lines; send it only when the user wants a different headline price (e.g. 299 instead of 300.42) — the server stores the difference as the read-only `priceAdjustment`. Must be left out (or 0) on a FREE plan or a plan with nothing paid in advance. On update: without `cost` the plan keeps its saved price, unless the entitlements you send really change (a line added or removed, or a line's billingMode, quantity, amount or rollover changed) — then it resets to the sum of the new ADVANCE lines at today's prices.

entitlements.description: At least one entitlement line. CREDIT/OUTCOME/UNIT lines reference an existing resource by id, and COMPOSITE references an existing composite by compositeId — create those first. The plan's currency is the workspace's primary currency; it isn't set here.

items.description: One entitlement line in the plan.

amount.description: USD. REQUIRED on a FLAT line (one-off fee, above 0) and on an ADVANCE WALLET line (prepaid balance granted each cycle; send 0 for an empty wallet, e.g. one carried only to fund metering). Not allowed on any other line. Plain wallet signals debit the wallet at raw model cost — no margin; ARREAR usage paid from the wallet (useWalletForArrear) debits it at customer price, margin included.

billingMode.description: ADVANCE bills up-front for the cycle (grants amount/quantity); ARREAR meters and bills what was consumed.

compositeId.description: COMPOSITE only: id of an existing, active composite (clocknext_list_composites). Plans read back with this same field, so a get_plan → update_plan round-trip keeps it. This line is the ONLY thing that makes a composite bill — the catalogue entry alone charges nobody.

creditId.description: CREDIT only: id of an existing, active credit (clocknext_list_credits).

id.description: UPDATE only: the id of a saved line on this plan (from clocknext_get_plan), to update that line. Leave it out to match the saved line of the same type and item, or to add a new line. Ignored on create. Line ids stay the same across updates until the line is removed.

outcomeId.description: OUTCOME only: id of an existing, active outcome (clocknext_list_outcomes).

quantity.description: REQUIRED on an ADVANCE CREDIT/OUTCOME/UNIT/COMPOSITE line: the quantity granted each cycle (whole number; 0 is allowed — the entitlement exists and can be topped up by hand). Not allowed on any other line (leave it out for ARREAR). For COMPOSITE + ADVANCE it is a prepaid POOL of composite-occurrence slots shared across the wrapped items: each distinct tag value claims one slot on completion, repeats reuse it; running past the pool is allowed and carries as debt into the next cycle.

rollover.description: ADVANCE CREDIT/OUTCOME/COMPOSITE/WALLET only: carry what's left this cycle into the next one instead of resetting. Default false. `true` on a UNIT, FLAT or ARREAR line, or on any line of a FREE plan, is refused (400).

type.description: The meter type of this entitlement line. COMPOSITE sells a composite: set compositeId.

unitId.description: UNIT only: id of an existing, active unit (clocknext_list_units).

useWalletForArrear.description: Pay metered usage from the wallet. Default false. When true, every metered (ARREAR) CREDIT/OUTCOME/UNIT/COMPOSITE line is paid FROM the customer's prepaid WALLET as usage happens — one invoice per cycle — instead of a separate arrear invoice at cycle end. The wallet may go negative mid-cycle; the next cycle's wallet top-up absorbs the overdraft. Backend rejects it (400) unless ALL THREE hold: (1) the plan has at least one ARREAR credit/outcome/unit/composite component; (2) the plan has a WALLET component; (3) that WALLET component is billingMode ADVANCE (a metered/ARREAR wallet is refused as double-billing). Margin is PRESERVED: wallet-funded ARREAR usage debits the wallet at the CUSTOMER price (margin included) — only plain type:'wallet' signals debit at raw model cost with no margin.
